# Discussion

## Main findings

Write this section from the frozen result tables. Lead with the strongest result,
not with every software component. Distinguish what was established about the UAE
referral cohort, what was established about assay observability, and what remains
unvalidated analytically.

## Interpretation

Discuss the advantage of modelling physical PCR products and chromosome
haplotypes instead of treating generic caller agreement as a biological genotype.
Ambiguity and no-call are substantive results when they follow from the declared
assay contract.

## Limitations

Separate data-access limitations, cohort ascertainment, selective reporting,
truth-set scope, assay calibration and candidate-catalogue incompleteness. Avoid
using time available as the scientific reason for a limitation.

## Next experiments

Prioritize assay-matched reference materials, paired historical/ONT cases where
linkage is recoverable, product-efficiency/dropout calibration, held-out external
assays and orthogonal confirmation of coherent novel products.
